circuit.title: Fairchild 670, one channel: generated by varimu.circuit.netlist

input_atten_db.source: sch: AT101 600 ohm T attenuator; [MAN] p.5 1 dB/step. Default: the factory adjustment's unity gain (above; [MAN] p.9 says ~10 dB). Range end (30 dB) is provisional: step count not legible

ac_threshold.source: sch: R115A / R115B dual tapped pot (front-panel knob; values below). Default: the factory adjustment (above)
ac_threshold.notes: the wipers' fraction of the track from the centre line: 0 = no signal to the sidechain (the manual's 'fully CCW', curve 1), 1 = the whole T103 secondary = lowest threshold

dc_threshold.source: sch: R117 100k (screwdriver beneath front panel). Default: the factory adjustment (above)
dc_threshold.notes: 0 = 12AX7 cathodes at ~3.6 V (lowest threshold; the manual's 'fully CW', curves 4 and 5), 1 = ~16 V

balance.source: sch: R105A/B dual 100 ohm (screwdriver, front panel)

zero.source: sch: R142 2500 ohm 'ZERO' between the bias supply's C108 node and ground (data/schematics/fairchild_670/README.md, supply rails). [MAN] p.7 sets it for a meter zero in S101's ZERO position, where the meter reads 15 ohm x the stage's total plate current; 0.3 idles each bank at 24.9 mA (scripts/calibrate_psu.py, 2026-10-21), against ~26 mA measured (web: https://groupdiy.com/threads/fairchild-670-questions.32169/)
zero.notes: standing 6386 grid bias = zero * the C108 node's voltage

b_plus_adj.source: sch: R313 250K 'B+ ADJ' (screwdriver, inside); [MAN] p.7: adjust only if pin 8 of V302 deviates from 240 V. Set so the settled rail is 240.0 V at the nominal genome (scripts/calibrate_psu.py, 2026-10-21)
b_plus_adj.notes: 0 = wiper at R312 (240 V side): the 6084 grid highest, the output lowest

mains_v_rms.source: [MAN] p.4: power 117 volts; stable over line voltage 100 to 127 volts

t101_leakage_h.source: provisional: chosen so the slice meets the published 40 Hz - 15 kHz +-1 dB (web: https://www.telefunken-elektroakustik.com/product/fairchild-670, reissue/dealer specs): measured 2026-10-21 with ngspice .ac on the linear-core build, -0.4 dB at 40 Hz, +0.2 dB at 15 kHz, the T101 secondary resonance at 35.5 kHz (+1.4 dB). The slice's former k = 0.999 (20 mH) gave +15 dB at 17.8 kHz once the lumped loss resistors were gone
t101_leakage_h.notes: referred to the primary (0.2 H referred to the 50k secondary)

t101_c_interwinding_f.source: provisional: nominal 0 = electrostatically screened (unknown for the original; unscreened line transformers have tens of pF)
t101_c_interwinding_f.notes: half from each grid end of the secondary to the primary hot end (balanced). 20 pF here plus 50 pF on T102 made the 6386 stage oscillate at ~31 kHz at idle (tuned-plate tuned-grid; measured 2026-10-21): the plausibility checks (Phase 4) must catch such units

t103_turns_half.source: web: https://www.sowter.co.uk/acatalog/VINTAGE-COMPRESSOR-TRANSFORMERS-A-to-K.html (replacement 8345E: 600 ohms/170k ohms, ratio 17+17:1+1) -> each secondary half = 8.5x the series primary (the two pads feed one primary here); the original's ratio isn't printed

t103_turns.source: provisional: derived (gave the former 5 H primary at nominal geometry and gap with mumetall's origin permeability then, 5,850; 7.9 H in the linear limit since the 2026-10-24 refit, see the transformer notes above)
t103_turns.notes: series primary (the reference winding); each secondary half has t103_turns_half times as many (10,330 at 8.5). The primary inductance doesn't depend on the ratio, so the ratio change (2026-10-23) left this value

t103_leakage_h.source: provisional: chosen so T103 standalone (its pads in front, the threshold pots' load behind) is within 0.5 dB from 40 Hz to 20 kHz, the era's rating for line-to-grid transformers (web: https://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-Electronics/40s/Electronics-1949-07.pdf, UTC's advertisement: +-1 dB 20-20,000 cycles; the replacement's response isn't published). Measured 2026-10-23: -0.20 / +0.08 / -0.45 dB at 40 Hz / 15 / 20 kHz. The former 10 mH (k = 0.999) gave -2.1 dB at 15 kHz once the ratio became 8.5 (it is 72x that referred to a secondary half)
